_comment: Controlled vocabularies. Functions are abstract roles a scheme step needs (used by the actor-removal check). Behaviour tags describe pattern features at risk-pattern level (used by MO classification). Both are ANALYST ASSUMPTIONS.

functions.course_enrolment: Enrols a person on a funded course
functions.fee_funding: Pays or funds the course fee (credits or sponsorship)
functions.attendance_attestation: Confirms attendance from the participant or supervisor side
functions.course_delivery_record: Creates delivery and attendance records for a course
functions.assessment_result: Issues the assessment outcome or certificate
functions.grant_claim_submission: Submits a grant or subsidy claim
functions.employment_record: Holds employment status used for eligibility
functions.incentive_payment: Transfers value to another actor outside the normal fee
functions.audit_evidence: Supplies records when a claim is checked
